Simple Notes Sync is a calm, private home for your notes and checklists. Everything lives on your device. When you want it everywhere, it syncs to your own server - no account, no cloud, no tracking. Ever.

 YOUR SERVER, YOUR RULES * Sync with any WebDAV server (Nextcloud, ownCloud, and more) * Use it across phone, tablet, and desktop * Decide when it syncs: on save, on open, on Wi-Fi, periodically, or on boot * Wi-Fi-only sync, VPN support, parallel transfers, self-signed SSL * Live sync progress, smart conflict resolution, server-deletion detection

 SHARE & EXPORT * Share notes as text or PDF * Export to your calendar
 BEAUTIFUL & LIGHT * Modern Material 3 interface built with Jetpack Compose * 7 color schemes including AMOLED black and Dynamic Color * Home-screen widgets: quick note and interactive checklist * Battery-friendly background sync
 PRIVATE BY DESIGN * No account, no ads, no tracking libraries * Your data never touches our servers - because we don't have any * Open source (AGPL-3.0) and under 5 MB, on a modern, well-tested Kotlin codebase

fdroid:app.tvviewer.player.name: TV Viewer - IPTV Streaming
fdroid:app.tvviewer.player.summary: Free open-source IPTV player with community channels and opt-in analytics.
fdroid:app.tvviewer.player.description:
TV Viewer is a free, open-source IPTV streaming app built around community-maintained playlists and privacy-first design.
Features:
• Live TV and radio channels from community-maintained sources
• Community Statistics page with anonymous aggregated usage insights
• Timezone-based country detection (no GPS or IP lookup needed)
• Background audio playback for radio streams
• Multi-source failover when one stream stops working
• Search, favorites, source selector, and watch history
• Picture-in-Picture (PiP) support where available
• No account required and no ads
• Optional usage and playback analytics (opt-in only)
• Optional community sharing is off by default; when enabled, health reports
 use URL hashes and new playlist channels may be shared with their stream URLs
• Self-hosted web/Docker edition also available
• Regular updates with new channels and fixes from the community
Privacy:
• No account or contact details collected
• No account or login required
• Analytics are off by default; optional playback events include channel names
 and URL hashes that can be matched to known streams
• Channel health reports and automatic playlist contributions are off by default
 and can be enabled in Settings; URL hashes may be matched to known stream URLs
• Country detection uses device timezone only
• All source code is open and auditable
This app does not host or provide any streams. It aggregates publicly available M3U playlists maintained by the open-source community (iptv-org and others). Channel availability depends on the source providers.
Network services:
• Channel playlists are fetched from community and third-party hosts
• FMStream.org is queried for public radio-station listings
• Supabase provides the shared channel database, aggregated community statistics, optional analytics, and URL-hashed channel-health exchange
• Analytics and channel health/playlist contributions require separate opt-ins
Permissions:
• Internet: Required to stream content
• Wake Lock: Keeps playback active when needed
• Foreground Service: Background audio playback notification

The author maintains these as a public service for anyone who does not want to self-host. To use a self-hosted sync server and/or SSO, change the URLs in the Connections screen (no rebuild needed). The SSO source is public at `https://gitlab.com/dowardev/sso`.

fdroid:com.earendel.tapbar.name: Tapbar
fdroid:com.earendel.tapbar.summary: Launch apps or quick actions from the status bar or anywhere on your screen
fdroid:com.earendel.tapbar.description:
Tapbar lets you create tappable zones anywhere on your screen. Tap a zone to open an app, run a quick action, or use an app shortcut, without opening the app drawer.
GESTURES
* Single tap, double tap, triple tap and long press, each with its own app, action or app shortcut
* Four independent tap zones, each with its own position, size and gestures
* Swipe gestures for adjusting volume and brightness
ACTIONS
* Open any installed app or app shortcut
* 75+ quick actions: flashlight, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Do Not Disturb, battery, sound, location, data usage, screenshot, power menu and more
CUSTOMIZATION
* Customize the position and size of each tap zone
* Edit numeric values directly
* Supports both portrait and landscape layouts
SMART BEHAVIOR
* Pause Tapbar in the apps you choose, with a searchable filter list
* Optional start on boot
* Haptic feedback: buzz on every tap, or when the action runs
* Light and dark themes
* Reset all settings with one slide
LANGUAGES
* English, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Nepali, Portuguese, Russian and Chinese
PRIVACY
* Works completely offline. Tapbar has no internet permission, no ads, no trackers and no analytics.
* The optional accessibility service is only used to place the tap zone over the status bar and to know which app is in front, so Tapbar can pause in apps you block. It does not read screen content.
* Without the accessibility service, Tapbar uses the overlay permission instead.
PERMISSIONS
* Display over other apps: Draws the tap zone
* Accessibility service: Places the zone on the status bar and detects the foreground app
* Notifications: Shows the service notification
* Do Not Disturb access and Modify system settings: Only for the actions that need them
* See all apps: Lists your apps in the app picker
* Start at boot: Optional auto start
Tapbar is free and open source under the MIT license.

fdroid:com.porter.tvremote.name: TV Remote
fdroid:com.porter.tvremote.summary: Install on your Android TV, then use any phone's browser as the remote
fdroid:com.porter.tvremote.description:
Install this app on your Android TV or Google TV, not on your phone. Your phone needs no app at all: it just opens the TV's address in its browser.
TV Remote turns your Android TV into a self-hosted web remote that any device on your local network can control — phone, tablet, laptop — without installing any app on the controller device.
HOW IT WORKS
The app runs a tiny HTTP server (port 8080) directly on your TV. Open http://<tv-ip>:8080 in any browser and you get a full remote control interface; the TV shows the exact address once you press Start Server. Input is injected via ADB loopback — the app connects to the TV's own ADB daemon at 127.0.0.1:5555, so no root is required.
FEATURES
• D-pad navigation (up, down, left, right, OK/Enter)
• Back, Home, Menu buttons
• Volume up / down / mute
• Power / sleep toggle
• Channel up / down rocker + numeric keypad (0–9)
• Keyboard text input — type into any focused field on the TV
• Google Assistant launch
• Works from any browser on the same LAN — no app needed on the controller
PRIVACY
Completely local. No data leaves your network. No accounts, no telemetry, no analytics, no ads.
REQUIREMENTS
• Android TV or Google TV device (Android 8.0+), with this app installed on the TV
• Developer Options enabled on the TV
• ADB over network enabled (TCP/IP mode, port 5555)
• Both the TV and the controller must be on the same LAN
The app starts automatically on boot and runs as a foreground service to stay alive when the TV is in use.
Open source (MIT) — source code at https://github.com/Legvan/tv-remote

fdroid:com.tuyafeng.watt.name: Watt
fdroid:com.tuyafeng.watt.description:
Watt is an open source Android component management application. It uses pm command to disable or enable components, requires root permissions.
 Features: 
* Disable or enable components(receivers/services/activities) easily
* Block a broadcast so that no app can receive it to wake itself
* Block the bad Keep-Alive services of some apps without errors
* No data collection
* Efficient and simple interface
 Why not IFW? 
In version 2.0, Watt has completely abandoned disabling components through the Intent Firewall, because ifw will cause android10+ devices to keep restarting. In view of this poor performance, Watt 2.0 uses pm commands to refactor the entire application.

fdroid:dev.rubec.otoscope.name: Otoscope
fdroid:dev.rubec.otoscope.summary: Ad-free viewer for WiFi otoscope cameras.
fdroid:dev.rubec.otoscope.description:
Otoscope is a clean, ad-free replacement for the proprietary apps shipped with cheap Wi-Fi otoscope cameras.
The stock companion apps generally bundle lots of ad and analytics SDKs (AdMob, AppLovin, IronSource, MBridge, Vungle, Pangle, Mintegral, etc.) and in-app tracking.
Otoscope reimplements essential connection and viewer functionalities, with nothing else.
Features:
• Discover the camera over Bluetooth Low Energy or Wi-Fi.
• Join the camera's Wi-Fi access point in a one-process scope, so the rest of your traffic isn't affected.
• Live video stream, decoded in-app over the camera's protocol (UDP or RTSP). Pure Kotlin, no FFmpeg, no native blobs.
• Auto-rotation driven by the camera's on-board accelerometer / gyro.
• Horizontal-mirror toggle for self-examination.
• Circular mask matching the otoscope lens.
• Photo and video capture with a built-in gallery to review, share and delete them.
• Optional caption burnt into the corner of each capture to tell what's being recorded.
Supported hardware families:
• Xylla — SSID `Enjoy-XXXXXX` or `JesHome-XXXX`.
• iTiMO — SSID `iTiMO-XXXXXX` or `jetion_XXXX`.
• JEGOAT — SSID `softish-XXXXXX`.
• EarFairy — SSID `Cooleer_XXXXXX`.
• Soulear (i4season) — SSID `Soulear-XXXXX`.
• Y38 — SSID `AIR-ES-XXXXXX`.
Otoscope is GPL-3.0-or-later and contains no third-party trackers, ad SDKs, or proprietary native libraries.

fdroid:godau.fynn.usagedirect.system.name: Museum of a broken API
fdroid:godau.fynn.usagedirect.system.summary: Warns against using a system usage stats API
fdroid:godau.fynn.usagedirect.system.description:
Please install usageDirect instead of this app if you are interested in system usage statistics. 
 This app reflects my experience with the usagae statistics API from a few Android versions ago. It may no longer be current and this app is no longer being maintained. 
The Android system collects app usage statistics in the background; however, native Android contains no way to read out this data properly. That is why I wanted to create a tool to display it. Unfortunately, I had to learn that this data source was riddled with bugs and highly unreliable.
Thus, I converted this application into a museum. It exhibits aggregated usage statistics per day for usually the past ten days, per week for the past four weeks, per month for the past six months as well as data aggregated by year. As a special exhibition, it can display this data as charts.
Design-wise, the app comes in the style of the settings app to highlight that this API is a part of the Android system.
An included Guide to the exhibition names some of the issues you can expect to find on your tour.

fdroid:io.github.iverlein.zanshin.name: Zanshin Calendar
fdroid:io.github.iverlein.zanshin.summary: Tibetan and Japanese calendars with almanac readings, and a meditation timer
fdroid:io.github.iverlein.zanshin.description:
Zanshin Calendar opens on today and shows it as a Tibetan almanac or the old Japanese calendar (旧暦) would: the lunar date, what the day is good for, what to put off, and when the sun rises, stands at noon and sets where you are. Tap a line and it tells you what it means. There is also a meditation timer, a mindfulness bell and a prayer wheel.
 Tibetan calendar, Phugpa (ཕུག་པ, phug pa) 
 The date: lunar day, month and year, including the days the calendar skips or doubles and the leap months.
 Festivals: Losar (ལོ་གསར, lo gsar), Chötrul Düchen (ཆོ་འཕྲུལ་དུས་ཆེན, cho 'phrul dus chen), Saga Dawa Düchen (ས་ག་ཟླ་བའི་དུས་ཆེན, sa ga zla ba'i dus chen), Chökhor Düchen (ཆོས་འཁོར་དུས་ཆེན, chos 'khor dus chen), Lhabab Düchen (ལྷ་བབས་དུས་ཆེན, lha babs dus chen) and others, plus the monthly observances on the 8th, 10th, 15th, 25th and 30th.
 A day in brief: the day's factors are weighed in the order the texts rank them, with the hours above the day. You get the tone of the day, the one factor that settles it, and what the lists call good or say to avoid. On today's page the answer follows the present hour.
 Choose a day: pick a wedding, a journey, a haircut or any other work, then a span of one to twelve months. The best days come ranked, with the good hours of each month.
 Your works: the ones you pin come first on the page, each with what the day makes of it. The haircut sits next to them with its good and bad days and hours, and your birth year adds your personal days.
 The hours: a round dial of the day. It marks each hour's combination period, Jupiter's nectar periods, the earth lords of the hour and the black hours. It also says what each hour suits, where the sun's four rough times fall and which works an hour turns against the day.
 The day's signs: lunar mansion, yoga, karaṇa, the element pair of weekday and mansion, and the animal, trigram (སྤར་ཁ, spar kha) and number of the lunar day. All of them have readings, and so do the special days, Rāhu's course, the earth lords and the direction of the astrologer spirit (བླ་མཁྱེན, bla mkhyen).
 Changes within the day: a second mansion, a skipped yoga or the span of Viṣṭi, each with its time, as the almanac of the White Beryl (བཻཌཱུར་དཀར་པོ, bai DUr dkar po) writes them.
 Mewa and links: the date's mewa (སྨེ་བ, sme ba) and what the activity lists hold it good or bad for. The twelve links (རྟེན་འབྲེལ, rten 'brel) are counted from the month's middle term, and each day's link comes with its works, directions and remedy.
 The hundred feet (རྐང་བརྒྱ, rkang brgya): the fangs of the moon, the sun, the five planets and Rāhu when they land on your birth mansion, and the spear and great spear on the moon's mansion.
 Month headings: the almanac opens each month by saying if it is long or short and which planet rises. It goes on to the black months, the seven days of the sage (དྲང་སྲོང, drang srong) and of the pig, and any comet its count marks.
 Eclipses: lunar and solar, found by the karaṇa reckoning (བྱེད་རྩིས, byed rtsis) of the Kālacakra (དུས་འཁོར, dus 'khor) as the almanac does it. They appear on their day with the merit they multiply.
 The bride's going: seventeen checks for you and your spouse, on any day and when you choose a wedding day.
 Earth lords: a compass for the year and another for the month. They show where each lord stands, the works it bars there and the remedy.

fdroid:io.github.valnesfjord.tgwsproxyrs.description:
Telegram MTProto WebSocket Bridge Proxy — a Rust vibecoded port of
 Flowseal/tg-ws-proxy .
 Listens for Telegram Desktop's MTProto connections on a local port and
tunnels them through WebSocket (TLS) connections to Telegram's DC servers.
 Telegram channel: @tg ws proxy_rs .
 Telegram Desktop → MTProto (TCP 1443) → tg-ws-proxy-rs → WS (TLS 443) → Telegram DC
 ↘ CF proxy (kws{N}.{cf-domain}) → Telegram DC (WS via Cloudflare)
 ↘ CF Worker (*.workers.dev) → Telegram DC (TCP tunnel via Cloudflare)
 ↘ upstream MTProto proxy → Telegram DC (WS fallback)
 ↘ direct TCP :443 → Telegram DC (last resort)
 Android app
 A minimal Jetpack Compose wrapper around the same core the CLI runs. Type the
flags you would pass to tg-ws-proxy , tap Start , and when the tg://proxy 
link appears tap it (or let the app open it) to add the proxy in Telegram.
 The listen address should be 127.0.0.1 so Telegram on the same phone can
connect.
 Add --secret <32 hex chars> if you want the link to stay the same across
restarts. --log-file is ignored; logs go to the on-screen view and logcat
( tg-ws-proxy ).
 The default arguments carry --quiet , so the on-screen Log panel stays
empty until you remove it. That is the default and not a failed start: drop
 --quiet (or swap it for --verbose ) before tapping Start to see log
lines. The tg:// link appears either way — it reaches the UI from the listen
callback rather than by scraping the log, so --quiet never hides it.

Don’t let the special characters or dots and dashes befuddle you.
Morse code is a system to encode letters and numbers to dash and dot signs.
The duration of the dash is three times the duration of a dot.
Each dot or dash is followed by period of signal absence, called a space, equal to the dot duration.
Morse code was first used for communicating via telegraph.
The most well-known Morse code is SOS, which is used to signal an emergency.
Aside from typing dots and dashed, you can also signal Morse code by turning light on and off, sounding a horn or tapping, etc.
All means of transmitting Mores code require the recipient understands it.
If not, our app may be used to find out the message, password, secret number, or any info you want to relay. 
Nowadays, even though the use of the telegraph has been widely superseded by other communication technologies, Morse code still finds its place in the lives of various individuals. Due to its presence in popular culture, Morse code has been featured in movies, games, and other medias as a simple way to encode messages, inspiring fans to research and explore the language as part of fun, puzzle-solving activities. This makes it useful even in cryptography or cryptogram events as a handy encoding tool.
1. Tell others when you are in a dangerous situation (SOS).
2. Hide your secret number or password via dots and dashes.
3. Cipher or decipher hidden clues in games.
4. Learn cryptography or cryptogram through learning Morse codes.
5. Become a codebreaker by breaking secret codes in real time translation.
6. Create a secret number.
+ Many more

flathub:io.github.falldaemon.engplayer.name: EngPlayer
flathub:io.github.falldaemon.engplayer.description:
EngPlayer is a modern, fast, and lightweight media player developed with Python and GTK4 for Linux desktops.
 It serves as a user-friendly entertainment hub that brings your local media library, VOD content, Podcasts, and live streams under one roof.
 Key Features:
 IPTV Support: Seamless integration with Xtream Codes API and M3U playlists.
 Smart EPG & Catch-up: Real-time program guides and archive playback support.
 Recorder (PVR): Record live streams or schedule recordings for later.
 Podcast Integration: Manage library, listen to episodes, and smart resume support.
 External Stream: Direct playback support for external video and audio URLs.
 Cinematic VOD: Automatic metadata fetching (Posters, Cast, Plot) via TMDb integration.
 Trakt.tv Sync: Automatically tracks what you're watching (Scrobbling).
 Local Library: Manage your Video, Music, and Picture collections with album art support.
 Advanced Player: Video Settings (Brightness/Contrast), 10-Band Equalizer, Subtitle download, and PiP mode.

flathub:io.github.mrgilfy.leggio.name: Leggio
flathub:io.github.mrgilfy.leggio.description:
Leggio shows your sheet music PDFs on screen, so you can put a laptop or tablet on a music stand
 and play from it instead of from paper.
 It keeps a library of your scores, which you can search by title, composer or tag and group
 into setlists. Scores open fullscreen with nothing else in the way, and pages turn instantly.
 What it does:
 Cuts off the white margins, so the notes fill the screen
 Turn pages by tap, swipe, keyboard or Bluetooth pedal, also half a page at a time
 Two pages side by side on a wide screen, one page on a tall one
 Add jump links to a D.S., D.C. or To Coda, then follow them with one tap
 Bookmarks and a page overview, for finding your way in long scores
 Draw on a score with a pen, highlighter, eraser and musical symbols
 Export a score or a setlist as a PDF with your annotations drawn in
 Night mode turns pages white-on-black for dark stages
 A setlist reads as one long document, several scores in a row
 Remembers where you stopped in each score, and keeps the screen from going to sleep while
 you play
 Your PDF files are never changed. Everything Leggio saves is kept in its own library. The Flatpak
 only sees the folders you choose.

 Clone two or more PDF pages on one PDF page
 Extract images from a PDF file
 Export PDF pages to JPG and PNG images
 Glue two PDF pages together to print them with a plotter
 Add, move and delete pages in a PDF document

flathub:net.labymod.LabyMod.name: Laby Launcher
flathub:net.labymod.LabyMod.description:
Laby Launcher delivers LabyMod, the ultimate free all-in-one client for Minecraft: Java Edition,
 bundling 300+ mods, 3D voice chat, cosmetics and a modern launcher into a single download for Windows,
 macOS and Linux. Beyond LabyMod, the launcher also lets you create and run instances for Vanilla,
 Fabric, Forge and Quilt, so everything you play lives in one place.
 What you get:
 Incredible performance - Freezes, lags and poor FPS are a thing of the past. With
 doubled performance your game feels smoother than ever before.
 Your game, your style - Switch at any time between a stunning, high-resolution modern
 theme and the classic, iconic Minecraft look.
 Built-in VoiceChat - Free in-game voice chat with 3D surround sound and proximity
 audio on every multiplayer server - no plugins, no setup required.
 Cosmetics with character - Handcrafted, passionately animated and highly customizable
 cosmetics, plus a skin and cape library with 3D preview and support for your own uploads.
 Reinvented screenshots - Capture and share 3D screenshots with automatic player
 tagging.
 Stay connected - A server-independent friends chat with tabs and a freely movable
 chat window keeps you in touch wherever you play.
 One launcher for everything - Create instances for Vanilla, Fabric, Forge and Quilt,
 each with its own mods and configuration, and import existing setups from launchers like MultiMC

 Note: LabyMod is not an official Minecraft product. It is not approved by or associated with
 Mojang or Microsoft.

flathub:net.odamex.Odamex.name: Odamex
flathub:net.odamex.Odamex.summary: Fast, faithful Classic DOOM action — solo or online
flathub:net.odamex.Odamex.description:
Odamex is a multiplayer-oriented DOOM port with a focus on classic DOOM gameplay. Perfect for playing with friends or alone,
 Odamex is faithful to the original DOOM games. It has the ability to play back vanilla demos,
 while also providing an enhanced experience with modern quality-of-life features and expanded modding capabilities.
 Features include:
 General Improvements on the Original Games:
 Can play many DOOM engine games, including Ultimate DOOM, DOOM II, Final DOOM, Freedoom, Chex Quest, Hacx, and REKKR
 Supports many modern editing features, such as “limit removing”, Boom, MBF, MBF21, and ID24
 Supports Hexen format and older ZDoom format maps
 Uncapped framerate
 High resolutions
 Widescreen support up to 32:9 ratio (ultra widescreen)
 32-bit color renderer
 Multiple ways to playback MIDI music, including an FM Synth emulator to rekindle those 1990s memories
 Supports MOD and other tracker music, MP3, and OGG in custom wads
 Quake-style console and key bindings
 Crosshairs
 Extended HUD
 Mouselook, jumping, swimming, and flying
 Walk over/under monsters and other things
 Unmatched Online Experience:
 Support for up to 255 players at once
 Top tier network code. Play with your friends on the other side of the world!
 Unlagged - Odamex will compensate for poor network conditions
 In-game wad downloading
 On-the-fly wad loading (servers can run hundreds of wads without you disconnecting!)
 Vote to change server settings such as fraglimit, timelimit, map, and more (must be enabled on server)
 Custom player colors
 Exciting Multiplayer Gamemodes:
 Cooperative & Survival
 Deathmatch / Team Deathmatch
 Last Man Standing / Team Last Man Standing
 Capture the Flag
 The Cacoward winning Horde mode
 And more!
 To use your own Timidity config file, use this command: flatpak override net.odamex.Odamex --env=TIMIDITY_CFG=<config location>

 A copy of DOOM, DOOM II, Final DOOM, Freedoom, Hacx, REKKR, or Chex Quest is required. If you do not own DOOM, it can be purchased on GOG or Steam.

flathub:org.gnome.Mahjongg.name: Mahjongg
flathub:org.gnome.Mahjongg.summary: Match tiles and clear the board
flathub:org.gnome.Mahjongg.description:
Single-player tile-matching game, commonly known as Mahjong solitaire.
 Tiles are stacked on the board at the start of the game. The goal is to
 remove all the tiles in as little time as possible.
 Select two matching tiles and they will disappear from the board, but
 you can only select a tile if there is an empty space to its left or
 right at the same level. Be careful: tiles that look alike may actually
 be slightly different.
 You can choose from a variety of starting layouts, some easy and some
 difficult. If you get stuck, you can ask for a hint, but this adds a
 large time penalty.

firefox-addons:2868408.summary: A browser extension that reveals password inputs when the cursor hovers over fields with the `password` type
firefox-addons:2868408.description:
Show/hide passwords is a handy and reliable Firefox extension designed to implement a new option just below password fields to show or hide the passwords.
With this extension installed, whenever you're filling a password field, you can easily enable the browser to show it, so you don't type it incorrectly.

apple-itunes:6746246179.description:
Foodie Sizzle – Master the Art of Grilling in a Sizzling Match-3 Adventure! 
Step into the vibrant world of Skewer Sort, where you become the ultimate grill master, crafting mouthwatering skewers in a thrilling match-3 puzzle experience! Strategically arrange juicy meats, fresh seafood, and colorful veggies to create perfect combos and serve up delicious delights.
How to Play: 
- Match & Grill: Swap and align three identical skewers to clear them from the grill. 
- Plan Wisely: Use limited moves to complete each level’s unique challenges. 
- Boost Your Skills: Unleash powerful tools like flame boosters and grill flips to overcome tricky obstacles! 
Why You’ll Love Foodie Sizzle?
Diverse Ingredients: From tender chicken to exotic seafood, every skewer is a feast for the eyes! 
Exciting Challenges: Race against moves, beat tricky layouts, and master special elimination mechanics. 
Power-Ups & Strategy: Think fast, grill smarter—use boosters to turn up the heat when the stakes are high! 
Whether you're a puzzle pro or a grilling newbie, Foodie Sizzle offers a fresh, flavorful twist on match-3 fun. Can you handle the heat and become the ultimate skewer champion? Let the grilling begin!

apple-itunes:463981119.name: NewsBlur: RSS News Reader
apple-itunes:463981119.description:
Follow the sites you care about with NewsBlur, a personal RSS news reader that brings your reading together. Keep up with news, blogs, newsletters, and more, with your subscriptions and reading progress synced across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.
READ YOUR WAY
Browse stories from individual sites or bring a folder together in one reading list. Choose a comfortable theme, adjust the text, and use gestures to move through your stories. Download stories for offline reading and pick up where you left off.
STORIES AT A GLANCE
Add widgets to your Home Screen. Each widget can show All Site Stories, a folder, or one site. Choose its source with Edit Widget.
A MORE LIVELY READER
Feeds, folders, story titles, and articles arrive with gentle animation. Switch between All, Unread, Focus, and Saved with responsive transitions. Prefer less movement? Turn on Reduce motion in Appearance to keep the fades without the sliding and scaling.
FIND YOUR FOCUS
Train NewsBlur on authors, tags, and words in headlines to highlight stories you want and hide ones you don't. You decide what matters.
DISCOVER AND KEEP
Find new sites, preview their latest stories, and try reading before subscribing. Save stories for later, organize them with tags, and search your reading. Share stories with comments on your NewsBlur blurblog and follow what friends are reading.
LISTEN TO YOUR STORIES
Turn articles into audio with voices in 21 languages. Follow highlighted paragraphs, tap to jump ahead, adjust playback speed, and queue stories in Up Next. Keep listening with the screen locked. Premium Archive includes 1 hour of listening per week, and Premium Pro includes 10 hours per week. Allowances reset every Sunday. Auto-continue follows your chosen list order in Saved Stories and Read Stories. Free and Premium accounts can try 30-second previews.
GO DEEPER
Use Text view to read an extracted article. Ask AI for a summary, background, or answers to questions about a story. Availability and usage limits depend on your account plan.
IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Use NewsBlur's interface in 21 languages, including right-to-left layouts for Arabic and Hebrew. Choose your language in Preferences or follow your device settings. Stories stay in the language they were published in.
A NewsBlur account is required. Free accounts and optional paid subscriptions are available. Some features require a paid plan.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
If you purchase a subscription through the App Store, payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of use: https://www.newsblur.com/tos
Privacy policy: https://www.newsblur.com/privacy

apple-macos:6779991756.description:
Punktfunk is the next generation of local game streaming. Stream from your Linux PC, headless server or laptop to your Apple devices — with low latency and built-in support for virtual displays. That means the resolution matches exactly the device you are streaming to. Windows hosts are supported as well. Both our client apps and the server/host are open source. Punktfunk sets itself apart from existing solutions through lower latency, which we achieve with our own QUIC-based protocol.
More features:
• Comprehensive DualSense controller support (adaptive triggers, LEDs and rumble)
• Xbox controller support
• Microphone passthrough: optionally forward the microphone from your client to the host
• Heavily optimised client with Metal-based rendering
• 1 Gbps+ ready: a lot of work went into supporting high bitrates, so high resolutions and refresh rates are possible. Requires a good network/Wi-Fi
• (Experimental) Browse the host's game library on the client and launch games directly
• Windows hosts: 10-bit colour and HDR support
• Statistics: glass-to-glass latency measurement
• Mouse and keyboard support

apple-macos:1494196015.name: SeeMusic
apple-macos:1494196015.description:
The complete studio for piano visuals.
Record performances, edit MIDI, and visualize your playing in real time.
Create beautiful videos with falling notes, glowing lights, and stunning effects.
Used by top YouTube creators, music educators, and pianists worldwide.
CREATE
• Import a MIDI file and turn it into a piano video
• Record synchronized MIDI, audio, and camera video, in any combination
• Use AI to convert piano audio recordings into MIDI for falling-note visuals
• Add your own piano footage, customize the visualization, and export your video
PERFORM
• Connect a MIDI keyboard and visualize every note in real time
• Perform with responsive colors, lights, particles, and effects
• Create live piano visuals for livestreams and concerts
EXPLORE
• Open MIDI files and MusicXML scores
• Follow synchronized sheet music as the music plays
• Reveal pitches, patterns, and harmony through color
DESIGN YOUR VISUAL WORLD
• Create a realistic 3D grand piano scene with animated keys and hammers, reactive lighting, and customizable camera movement
• Add particles from presets or refine their gravity, friction, turbulence, and blending
• Simulate LED strip lighting and shadows, even when you record without an LED strip
• Blend your piano footage with atmospheric Saber glow effects
CREATE YOUR SIGNATURE STYLE
• Choose single-color, 12-color, gradient, track, or random note colors
• Explore 2D and 3D note styles, including gems, crystals, and reflective glass
• Customize note shapes and materials, or apply your own textures
• Import images or videos as custom backgrounds
• Save and reuse visual presets for a consistent look across videos
EDIT AND SYNCHRONIZE
• Add, remove, split, join, move, and change note length
• Adjust pitch, timing, velocity, tracks, tempo, and playback
• Synchronize MIDI, audio, and video
• Automatically detect and align the keyboard in your footage
• Isolate your hands and keys, with keying, color, and lighting controls
• Crop, rotate, and position your piano footage
FINISH AND SHARE
• Record on mobile, then transfer your recording to SeeMusic on desktop for editing and video creation
• Create widescreen or vertical videos for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and more
• Export in up to 4K at 60 FPS, with rendering optimized for desktop and mobile
• Choose your format, resolution, frame rate, and quality
• Save complete projects with their presets and media
MAKE MUSIC VISIBLE
Give each of the 12 musical pitches its own color. Add pitch names, solfège, guides, bar lines, and other musical references to see familiar music from an entirely new perspective.
Use SeeMusic to create videos for social media, produce visuals for live performances, or discover more in the music you play.
